name: Formloom
tagline: Drag-and-drop form and survey builder that needs no server
description: For people who collect responses and don't have a developer: event organisers, small shops, hiring managers. Build a form by dragging fields, share it as a single link, and read the answers in a table and charts.
scope: Three-pane builder with validation and conditional logic
Respondent view and share links with the form in the URL
Response table, per-question charts and CSV export
features: 13 field types, added and reordered by pointer drag, keyboard or buttons, with undo and redo
Required, min/max, regex and custom-message validation, enforced in a real respondent view
Show-when logic across chained questions and pages, with loops blocked in the builder and contained on import
Share links that hold the whole compressed form, opening straight in respondent mode
Sortable, filterable response table, hand-built SVG summary charts, and RFC 4180 CSV export
JSON export and import of forms, five templates, and per-form themes
engineering: The logic evaluator finds loops up front with Tarjan's strongly connected components, so results never depend on evaluation order, and share links use a hand-written LZW codec with a primed dictionary and a checksum that rejects truncated links.
